cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(prelinkstamp C)

# A target with a PRE_LINK build-event command that GENERATES a source file as a
# BYPRODUCT (the "stamp" pattern). cmake folds the command onto producer's link
# edge and lists gen_impl.c as an extra output of that LINKER edge — so the
# converter must recover it as a genrule (recoverGenrule can't: the producing
# rule isn't a CUSTOM_COMMAND) for the consumer below to resolve.
add_library(producer STATIC producer.c)
add_custom_command(TARGET producer PRE_LINK
  COMMAND cp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen_impl.c.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen_impl.c
  BYPRODUCTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen_impl.c
  COMMENT "generate gen_impl.c before link")

# consumer compiles the generated byproduct as one of its sources.
add_library(consumer STATIC consumer.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen_impl.c)
set_source_files_properties(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen_impl.c PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE)
add_dependencies(consumer producer)
